mutation_testing::setup.cfg.head:
[coverage:run]
branch = False
# `taskq_plus/__main__.py` is the dedicated `python -m taskq_plus`
# entry-point module: its only executable body is the
# `if __name__ == "__main__":` guard, which by construction never runs
# under an import-based test harness. Per the Gate 1 pragma policy an
# entry-point module is excluded at FILE level here rather than being
# annotated with `# pragma: no cover` inline.
omit =
    03-development/src/taskq_plus/__main__.py
    */taskq_plus/__main__.py

[mutmut]
# Scoped per the SAB NFR-08: mutation testing judges ONLY the
# service-layer business logic (task execution, DAG, cache, breaker,
# plugins) and the storage layer (task_store, breaker_store,
# cache_store). CLI/observability/models/config are excluded because
# the harness treats them as thin glue that mutmut wastes budget on.
# Paths must match the SAB's mutation_testing scope_layers verbatim —
# the gate finaliser compares strings and reports a scope disagreement
